# Construction Professional Liability Insurance

> Construction Professional Liability Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides professional liability (E&O) and supporting commercial lines for design-build contractors and construction firms in all 50 states. Coverage lines: construction professional liability (E&O), general liability, workers' compensation, commercial auto, umbrella/excess liability, builders risk, and contractors pollution liability. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
